title: What If Every Shark in the Ocean Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every shark vanished? The first casualty would be a scallop.
Sharks sit at the top of the ocean food web. Remove them, and the animals they eat lose their main hunter.
It has already happened on the US East Coast. Large sharks were functionally eliminated, and cownose rays exploded in number.
Those rays eat bay scallops. They wiped them out, and scallops became harder to find at market.
Off South Africa, great whites left False Bay by 2018. Seals and sevengill sharks surged, and smaller fish dropped sharply.
Over half of all sharks and rays have disappeared since 1970. The experiment is already running.

description:
What if every shark vanished?
Loss of the top predator already rewired food webs off the US East Coast and South Africa.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Which ocean animal would you save first? Tell us your next what-if.
